title: Vacancy Announcement: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Officer

headings.text: Vacancy Announcement: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Officer

key_sentences: LARL is a non-profit organisation that helps smallholder farmers around Lake Kyoga to raise their incomes and adapt to a changing climate.
We currently work with 18,000 households in five districts.
Send a cover letter and a CV of no more than three pages to jobs@larl.example, quoting the reference number in the subject line.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
LARL does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

rows: Mbale, with frequent travel to Bukedea and Kumi
Two years, renewable subject to funding and performance

list_items.text: Maintain the programme’s results framework and indicator reference sheets.
Plan and supervise baseline, midline and endline surveys.
Train field officers in data collection and data quality checks.
Prepare quarterly progress reports and dashboards for donors and partners.
Organise learning reviews with farmer groups and district officials.
A bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, agriculture or a related field
At least three years of experience in monitoring and evaluation, including:
designing household surveys and sampling plans
managing data collection on mobile phones or tablets
Strong skills in spreadsheets and in at least one statistical package
Fluency in English; knowledge of Ateso or Lusoga is an advantage

furniture: Plot 22, Kanyanja Road · P.O. Box 4187, Mbale, Uganda
LARL is an equal opportunity employer. Women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
notes: The vacancy details box is a 2-column key/value table with NO header row. The second qualification item has two level-1 sub-items. The logo box text 'LARL' is letterhead furniture.
